{id:'bean',name:'Bean',latin:'Phaseolus vulgaris',icon:'🫘',tags:['vegetables','seeds'],site:'garden',fact:'A bean is a seed. A bean seed can grow into a plant that makes pods.'},

{id:'tomato',name:'Tomato',latin:'Solanum lycopersicum',icon:'🍅',tags:['fruit','vegetables','seeds'],site:'garden',fact:'A tomato is a botanical fruit. It develops from a flower and contains seeds.'},

{id:'carrot',name:'Carrot',latin:'Daucus carota subsp. sativus',icon:'🥕',tags:['vegetables','seeds'],site:'garden',fact:'We eat the swollen root of a carrot. It usually flowers and makes seeds in a later season.'},

{id:'lettuce',name:'Lettuce',latin:'Lactuca sativa',icon:'🥬',tags:['vegetables','seeds'],site:'hydro',fact:'Lettuce leaves collect light. Lettuce can grow in soil or in a carefully managed hydroponic system.'},

{id:'sunflower',name:'Sunflower',latin:'Helianthus annuus',icon:'🌻',tags:['flowers','seeds'],site:'garden',fact:'A sunflower head contains many tiny flowers. Its familiar seed snack includes a seed inside a dry fruit.'},

{id:'marigold',name:'French marigold',latin:'Tagetes patula',icon:'🌼',tags:['flowers','seeds'],site:'biodome',fact:'Marigolds are flowering plants. Flowers can provide food for visiting pollinators.'},

{id:'apple',name:'Apple',latin:'Malus domestica',icon:'🍎',tags:['trees','fruit','seeds'],site:'orchard',fact:'Apple trees make flowers before fruit. A seed-grown apple tree may differ from the parent tree.'},

{id:'orange',name:'Sweet orange',latin:'Citrus sinensis',icon:'🍊',tags:['trees','fruit','seeds'],site:'orchard',fact:'An orange is a fruit from a flowering tree. Some varieties have few or no mature seeds.'},
{id:'oak',name:'English oak',latin:'Quercus robur',icon:'🌳',tags:['trees','nuts','seeds'],site:'orchard',fact:'An acorn is a nut containing an oak seed. Oak pollen is carried mainly by wind.'},
{id:'almond',name:'Almond',latin:'Prunus dulcis',icon:'🌰',tags:['trees','nuts','seeds'],site:'orchard',fact:'The almond we eat is a seed inside a hard shell. It is called a nut in cooking.'},
{id:'wheat',name:'Wheat',latin:'Triticum aestivum',icon:'🌾',tags:['seeds'],site:'vertical',fact:'Wheat is a grass. A grain contains a seed joined closely to its fruit wall.'},
{id:'rice',name:'Rice',latin:'Oryza sativa',icon:'🌾',tags:['seeds'],site:'hydro',fact:'Rice is a grass grown for its grain. Different rice-growing systems manage water in different ways.'},
{id:'pea',name:'Pea',latin:'Pisum sativum',icon:'🫛',tags:['vegetables','seeds'],site:'vertical',fact:'A pea is a seed inside a pod. Many pea flowers can pollinate themselves.'},

{id:'strawberry',name:'Garden strawberry',latin:'Fragaria × ananassa',icon:'🍓',tags:['fruit','seeds'],site:'vertical',fact:'The tiny dots on a strawberry are little dry fruits, each containing a seed. Many plants spread by runners too.'},

{id:'maple',name:'Red maple',latin:'Acer rubrum',icon:'🍁',tags:['trees','seeds'],site:'biodome',fact:'Maples have winged fruits that carry seeds. Spinning wings help seeds travel away from the tree.'}
{id:'farm-hydro',x:180,y:160,icon:'💧',name:'Hydro farm',page:'hydro',fact:'Plants need nutrients as well as water.'},
{id:'farm-orchard',x:840,y:160,icon:'🌳',name:'Orchard',page:'orchard',fact:'An orchard is an area where fruit or nut trees grow.'},
{id:'farm-vertical',x:180,y:280,icon:'🥬',name:'Vertical garden',page:'vertical',fact:'Growing in layers can save floor space, but plants still need light.'},
{id:'farm-solar',x:400,y:280,icon:'☀️',name:'Solar panels',page:'solar',fact:'Solar panels change light energy into electrical energy.'},
{id:'farm-water',x:620,y:280,icon:'🌧️',name:'Water lab',page:'water',fact:'Water moves through the environment and can be reused after suitable treatment.'},
{id:'farm-power',x:840,y:280,icon:'⚡',name:'Energy lab',page:'power',fact:'Sunlight, wind and flowing water can supply energy.'},
{id:'farm-bank',x:180,y:400,icon:'🫘',name:'Seed bank',page:'bank',fact:'Seed banks care for stored seeds. Different seeds need different storage conditions.'},
{id:'farm-computer',x:400,y:400,icon:'💻',name:'Plant computer',page:'library',fact:'Plants can belong to more than one useful group.'},
{id:'farm-leaf',x:620,y:400,icon:'🔬',name:'Leaf lab',page:'leaf',fact:'Chlorophyll helps capture light energy for photosynthesis.'},

const farmExperiments={growth:['I explored plant growth.','farm-garden'],greenhouse:['I changed the greenhouse.','farm-biodome'],hydro:['I tried the water pump.','farm-hydro'],pollination:['I moved pollen to a flower.','farm-orchard'],water:['I explored the water cycle.','farm-water'],recycle:['I reused farm water.','farm-water'],energy:['I tried renewable energy.','farm-power'],leaf:['I looked inside a leaf.','farm-leaf'],robot:['I helped PIP tend plants.','farm-robot']};

function normalizeFarm(input={}){const f=defaultFarm();if(!input||typeof input!=='object')return f;f.seeds=[...new Set((Array.isArray(input.seeds)?input.seeds:[]).filter(id=>farmPlants.some(p=>p.id===id)))];f.experiments=[...new Set((Array.isArray(input.experiments)?input.experiments:[]).filter(id=>farmExperiments[id]))];for(const k of ['shade','vent','pump','sun','wind','flow'])f[k]=input[k]===true;for(const [k,max]of [['growth',5],['pollen',3],['water',4],['recycle',3],['zoom',3],['robot',3]])if(Number.isInteger(input[k])&&input[k]>=0&&input[k]<=max)f[k]=input[k];return f}

if(action.type==='collect'){const p=farmPlants.find(p=>p.id===action.id);if(p){if(!f.seeds.includes(p.id)){f.seeds.push(p.id);message=p.name+' sample seed saved.'}else message=p.name+' is already safe in my seed bank.';route='plant:'+p.id;}}

if(page==='home')return view('Planet Farm','Explore. Grow. Collect. Come back any time.','🌱  💧  ☀️',[go('🌿 Plant computer','library'),go('🫘 My seed bank','bank'),go('🌱 Growth lab','growth'),go('🔬 Leaf lab','leaf'),go('💧 Water lab','water'),go('⚡ Energy lab','power')]);

if(page==='library')return view('Plant computer','Fifteen familiar examples. A plant can belong to several groups.','🌼 🌳 🍎 🥕',arg==='more'?[...farmCategories.slice(5).map(([id,name,icon])=>go(icon+' '+name,'list:'+id+':0')),go('← More plant groups','library'),back]:[...farmCategories.slice(0,5).map(([id,name,icon])=>go(icon+' '+name,'list:'+id+':0')),go('Nuts and seeds →','library:more')]);

return view(page==='bank'?'My seed bank':page==='tray'?'Sample seed tray':(farmCategories.find(c=>c[0]===category)?.[1]||'Plants'),group.length?(page==='bank'?'My sample seeds are saved here. Real seeds need suitable storage for their species.':'Tap a plant to look closer. Seeds are keepsakes, not points.'):'My seed bank is ready. Visit a sample tray to collect a seed.','🫘 → 🌱',rows);

if(page==='plant'||page==='sample'){const p=farmPlants.find(p=>p.id===arg);if(!p)return farmView(f,'library');return view(p.name,p.fact,p.icon,[...(page==='sample'?[{label:f.seeds.includes(p.id)?'✓ Seed saved':'＋ Collect sample seed',action:{type:'collect',id:p.id}}]:[{label:'📍 Visit sample tray',action:{type:'travel',id:p.id}}]),go('🫘 My seed bank','bank'),go('🌿 Plant computer','library')]);}

if(page==='hydro')return view('Hydro farm','Hydroponics grows plants without soil. Roots still need water, dissolved nutrients and oxygen. Light powers plant growth.',f.pump?'💧 → 🌱 → 💧  Pump ON':'💧  🌱  Pump resting',[toggle('💧 '+(f.pump?'Rest pump':'Run pump'),'pump'),go('🫘 Sample seeds','tray:hydro:0'),go('♻ Water recycling','recycle'),back]);

if(page==='biodome')return view('Biodome greenhouse',(f.shade?'Shade reduces incoming light. ':'Sunlight can warm the greenhouse. ')+(f.vent?'Open vents let warm air leave.':'Closed vents hold more warm air.')+' Growers also watch temperature, moisture and air. This is a simple model.',(f.shade?'⛱️':'☀️')+' → 🫧 '+(f.vent?'🌬️':'♨️'),[toggle(f.shade?'☀️ Open shade':'⛱️ Add shade','shade'),toggle(f.vent?'Close vent':'🌬️ Open vent','vent'),go('🫘 Sample seeds','tray:biodome:0'),back]);

if(page==='growth'){const stages=[['Seed','A seed contains a tiny plant and stored food.','🫘'],['Germination','Water, oxygen and a suitable temperature help a seed start growing. Light needs vary.','🫘 → 🌱'],['Seedling','Roots take in water and mineral nutrients. New leaves capture light.','🌱'],['Growing plant','Leaves make sugars using light, water and carbon dioxide.','🌿'],['Flowers','Many plants make flowers when mature. For some plants this takes another season.','🌼'],['Fruit and seeds','After fertilization, flowers can form fruits containing seeds. Different plants take different amounts of time.','🌼 → 🫛 → 🫘']];const st=stages[f.growth];return view('Plant growth: '+st[0],st[1]+' Tap at your own pace. This model skips real growing time.',st[2],[step('▶ Next stage','growth'),go('🫘 Sample seeds','tray:garden:0'),go('🐝 Pollination','pollination'),back]);}

if(page==='orchard')return view('Orchard','Fruit and nut trees grow here. Flowers come before many fruits. Farmers care for soil, water, light and pollinators.','🌳 🍎 🌰',[go('🫘 Tree sample seeds','tray:orchard:0'),go('🐝 Try pollination','pollination'),go('🌱 Growth stages','growth'),back]);

if(page==='vertical')return view('Vertical garden','Growing plants in layers saves floor space. Each layer still needs light, water, nutrients and air.','🌿\n🌿\n🌿',[go('🫘 Sample seeds','tray:vertical:0'),go('💧 Hydro farm','hydro'),back]);

if(page==='pollination'){const facts=['Pollen must reach the right part of a flower. Some plants use insects, others use wind or self-pollination.','A visiting bee can pick up pollen while finding food.','Pollen can move to a flower’s stigma. This is pollination.','Fertilization may follow pollination. Then seeds and fruits can develop.'];return view('Pollination',facts[f.pollen],['🌼  🐝  🌼','🌼 → 🐝','🐝 → 🌼','🌼 → 🫘'][f.pollen],[step('▶ Next step','pollen'),back]);}

if(page==='solar')return view('Solar panels','A solar panel changes light energy into electrical energy. A leaf uses light to make sugars. They use sunlight in different ways.',f.sun?'☀️ → ▦ → 💡':'☁️  ▦  ○',[toggle(f.sun?'☁️ Shade panel':'☀️ Light panel','sun'),go('🍃 Compare a leaf','leaf'),go('⚡ Energy lab','power'),back]);

if(page==='water'){const facts=['Sunlight helps liquid water evaporate into invisible water vapor.','As air cools, water vapor can condense into tiny droplets, forming clouds.','Water falls as rain or snow. This is precipitation.','Water collects in rivers, lakes, soil and oceans. Some moves underground.','Plants take up water. Water vapor can leave their leaves through transpiration. The cycle has many paths.'];return view('Water cycle',facts[f.water],['☀️ → 💧 → ↑','↑ → ☁️','☁️ → 🌧️','🌧️ → 🌊','🌱 → ↑ → ☁️'][f.water],[step('▶ Follow water','water'),go('♻ Reuse farm water','recycle'),back]);}

if(page==='recycle'){const facts=['Catch unused irrigation water.','A screen can remove some pieces of dirt. Screening does not remove every contaminant.','Water may need more treatment and checks before it is suitable for reuse.','Suitable water returns to the plants. Some water is lost, and nutrients need checking. Reused farm water is not automatically drinking water.'];return view('Water recycling',facts[f.recycle],['🌱 → 💧','💧 → ▤','▤ → 🔎','💧 → 🌱'][f.recycle],[step('▶ Next step','recycle'),go('🌧️ Water cycle','water'),back]);}

if(page==='power')return view('Renewable energy',(f.sun||f.wind||f.flow?'Our model lamp has an energy source. ':'Try a source to light our model lamp. ')+'Solar panels use light. Wind and moving water turn turbines. Pumping water uses energy; a pump loop is not free power.',(f.sun?'☀️ ':'')+(f.wind?'🌬️ ':'')+(f.flow?'🌊 ':'')+' → '+(f.sun||f.wind||f.flow?'💡':'○'),[toggle('☀️ Sun '+(f.sun?'ON':'OFF'),'sun'),toggle('🌬️ Wind '+(f.wind?'ON':'OFF'),'wind'),toggle('🌊 Flow '+(f.flow?'ON':'OFF'),'flow'),back]);

if(page==='leaf'){const levels=[['Leaf','A leaf is like a little sunlight collector. Its veins carry water and other materials. It does not make electricity like a solar panel.','🍃'],['Leaf cells','Leaves contain many cells. Tiny openings called stomata help gases move in and out.','▦  ▦  ▦'],['Chloroplasts','Many green leaf cells contain chloroplasts. Photosynthesis takes place here.','◉  ◉  ◉'],['Chlorophyll','Chlorophyll is a green pigment that absorbs light. Photosynthesis uses light energy, water and carbon dioxide to make sugars, releasing oxygen.','☀️ + 💧 + CO₂ → sugar + O₂']];const l=levels[f.zoom];return view('PIP zoom: '+l[0],l[1],l[2],[step('🔬 Zoom / repeat','zoom'),go('☀️ Compare solar panels','solar'),back]);}

if(page==='robot'){const facts=['PIP can help farmers observe plants. People choose the task.','A sensor can measure soil moisture or conditions in a growing system.','A controlled pump can deliver water where it is needed.','PIP reports the observation. People check the plants and equipment. This is an automatic demonstration, not a real crop diagnosis.'];return view('Farm robot helper',facts[f.robot],['🤖 → 🌱','🤖 → 🔎','🤖 → 💧','🤖 → 💬'][f.robot],[step('🤖 Let PIP help','robot'),back]);}

for(const [i,s]of farmStations.entries()){const colors=['#b7e5e4','#bce3ca','#c7daa8','#b4d0a3','#b3d5af','#dfdaa0','#a4d5dc','#d3dfbb','#e6d3a9','#b4d2ce','#c4dec7','#d2d8c1'];farmPlan.push({kind:'rect',x:s.x-80,y:s.y-35,w:170,h:85,color:colors[i]});if(s.id==='farm-orchard')for(const dx of [-55,50])farmPlan.push({kind:'ellipse',x:s.x+dx,y:s.y-6,w:18,h:26,color:'#5b8d65'});if(s.id==='farm-hydro'||s.id==='farm-vertical')for(const dy of [-14,9,31])farmPlan.push({kind:'rect',x:s.x-60,y:s.y+dy,w:120,h:6,color:s.id==='farm-hydro'?'#4a99b3':'#60916d'});if(s.id==='farm-solar')for(const dx of [-55,0,55])farmPlan.push({kind:'rect',x:s.x+dx-15,y:s.y-10,w:30,h:42,color:'#406a8b'});}

function farmSvg(){return '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1000" height="600">'+farmPlan.map(p=>p.kind==='rect'?`<rect x="${p.x}" y="${p.y}" width="${p.w}" height="${p.h}" rx="10" fill="${p.color}"/>`:p.kind==='ellipse'?`<ellipse cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" rx="${p.w}" ry="${p.h}" fill="${p.color}"/>`:`<text x="${p.x}" y="${p.y}" fill="${p.color}" font-size="${p.size}" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold">${p.text}</text>`).join('')+'</svg>';}
const leaf='<ellipse cx="155" cy="85" rx="90" ry="48" fill="#81ba67"/><path d="M80 118l155-68M128 97l-12-32m39 21 14 33m10-49 4-26" fill="none" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="5"/>';
const plant='<path d="M155 140V65" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="8"/><ellipse cx="130" cy="80" rx="28" ry="13" fill="#81ba67"/><ellipse cx="180" cy="102" rx="28" ry="13" fill="#81ba67"/>';

if(kind==='leaf'){if(i===0)art=leaf;if(i===1){for(let x=55;x<250;x+=50)for(let y=35;y<140;y+=48)art+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="43" height="40" rx="12" fill="#a4d58d" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="3"/>`;art+='<ellipse cx="155" cy="103" rx="8" ry="16" fill="#173f42"/>';}if(i===2){for(let x=70;x<260;x+=65){art+=`<ellipse cx="${x}" cy="83" rx="28" ry="48" fill="#91c97a" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="3"/>`;for(let y=60;y<120;y+=12)art+=`<rect x="${x-15}" y="${y}" width="30" height="6" fill="#39734d"/>`;}}if(i===3)art='<circle cx="55" cy="70" r="29" fill="#f4cf61"/><path d="M95 70h55m-10-10 10 10-10 10" fill="none" stroke="#f4cf61" stroke-width="7"/><ellipse cx="205" cy="80" rx="40" ry="55" fill="#4b9959"/><circle cx="270" cy="60" r="13" fill="#d7e9e4"/><circle cx="285" cy="105" r="13" fill="#d7e9e4"/>';}

else if(kind==='growth'){art='<rect x="40" y="135" width="240" height="25" rx="8" fill="#9a7858"/>';if(i===0)art+='<ellipse cx="155" cy="135" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#d6aa69"/>';else{art+=i<3?'<path d="M155 145V105" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="6"/><ellipse cx="139" cy="103" rx="20" ry="10" fill="#81ba67"/>':plant;if(i>=4)art+='<circle cx="155" cy="55" r="20" fill="#f3d35e"/><circle cx="155" cy="55" r="9" fill="#b17c4e"/>';if(i===5)art+='<ellipse cx="178" cy="89" rx="13" ry="30" fill="#a7ce78"/><circle cx="178" cy="74" r="4" fill="#39734d"/><circle cx="178" cy="89" r="4" fill="#39734d"/><circle cx="178" cy="104" r="4" fill="#39734d"/>';}}

else if(kind==='biodome'){art='<path d="M40 145V80a115 75 0 0 1 230 0v65z" fill="#c2e7dc" stroke="#6aa298" stroke-width="4"/>'+plant;if(i)art+='<path d="M45 50h220v28H45z" fill="#6c967b"/>';else art+='<circle cx="40" cy="28" r="21" fill="#f3d35e"/>';if(+extra)art+='<path d="M240 40h55m-38 15h38m-48 15h48" stroke="#4a99b3" stroke-width="5"/>';}

else if(kind==='pollination'){art='<path d="M85 145V75m145 70V75" stroke="#39734d" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="85" cy="65" r="24" fill="#e7a6c0"/><circle cx="230" cy="65" r="24" fill="#e7a6c0"/>';const x=[115,140,200,240][i];art+=`<ellipse cx="${x}" cy="80" rx="19" ry="12" fill="#f4cf61"/><path d="M${x} 69v22" stroke="#173f42" stroke-width="6"/><circle cx="${x+12}" cy="94" r="4" fill="#d3a351"/>`;if(i===3)art+='<ellipse cx="230" cy="112" rx="13" ry="25" fill="#81ba67"/>';}

function pathfind(from,to,zone='grounds'){const start=cellAt(...from),goal=cellAt(...to);if(blocked(...goal,zone))return [];const key=p=>p.join(',');const queue=[start],parents=new Map([[key(start),null]]);for(let i=0;i<queue.length;i++){const p=queue[i];if(key(p)===key(goal)){const out=[];let c=p;while(parents.get(key(c))!==null){out.push([c[0]*CELL+20,c[1]*CELL+20]);c=parents.get(key(c));}return out.reverse();}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=COLS||n[1]>=ROWS||blocked(...n,zone)||parents.has(key(n)))continue;parents.set(key(n),p);queue.push(n);}}return [];}

function arrive(o){s.last=o.id;if(o.kind!=='dig')s.visited.add(o.id);if(o.kind==='portal'){const next=s.journey;nativeZone(o.to);if(next)select(objects.find(x=>x.id===next));return}if(o.kind==='farm'){nativeFarm(o.page);return}if(o.kind==='workshop'){nativePipWorkshop();return}if(o.kind==='crew'){crewMenu();return}if(o.kind==='home'){say('Welcome home to the training grounds.
